Lord Marrowgar Strategy Guide

Overview

The fixture boss swings a big bone and keeps several made-up rules that only this test knows about. Everything here is synthetic, written to exercise the converter rather than to teach the fight.

Abilities

  • Bone Spike Graveyard pins a random player.
    • Nested detail about the spike.
  • Lord Marrowgar carries Bryntroll.
  • has no link text.

Tips for Tanks

Stand together for Saber Lash and face the boss away from the raid.

Icon text stays.

Dodge Coldflame lines.

Board  Orgrim's Hammer.
